title: ctenitis afra
intro: Ctenitis afra, commonly known as the African fern, is a plant species belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis afra include its ability to reduce inflammation, heal wounds, and exhibit antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis afra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
